Company reports only FFO and Core FFO; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Advocacy contributions is shown as an em dash for Q1 2023 and recorded as 0. Verified: 146,902 + adjustments = 355,258; 355,258 + core adjustments = 359,970. Shares 140,023,810 converted to 140,023.81 thousands; 355,258/140,023.81 = $2.54 and 359,970/140,023.81 = $2.57, matching reported per-share figures. Recurring capex not applicable since no AFFO is reported.
